Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics

Interface CollisionResolver

All Known Implementing Classes:
ImpulseResolver
public interface CollisionResolver
An interface with the methods necessary for a class used to resolve any collisions between Collideables.

    • putToRest

      void putToRest(Contact contact, float e)
      Resolves the given Contact with the given constant of restitution e. Used with a gradually increasing e going from -1 to 0 this method will put a contact to rest.
      Parameters:
      contact - the contact to resolve.
      e - the constant of restitution to use for the contact.

    • separate

      void separate(Contact contact, float amount)
      Separates the objects in a contact so that they no longer overlap.
      Parameters:
      amount - a float value from 0 to 1, how much of the overlap to prevent.
